scenes.tts: The first film followed inherited variants across generations. How can data show that selection, rather than chance, shaped a population shift? Return to the same teal and gold map, now tied to Gorongosa elephants.
scenes.caption: The first film followed inherited variants across generations. How can data show that selection, rather than chance, shaped a population shift? Return to the same teal and gold map, now tied to Gorongosa elephants.
scenes.visual: Open on the carried population field from the first film. Teal means tuskless inherited variant; gold means tusked inherited variant. The schematic markers transform into simple elephant silhouettes, then into three empty data bars.
scenes.narration: The first film followed inherited variants across generations. How can data show that selection, rather than chance, shaped a population shift? Return to the same teal and gold map, now tied to Gorongosa elephants.

scenes.visual: Brief title card, Reading Selection in a Population. Teal and gold elephant markers continue moving slowly behind the title.

scenes.tts: Teal marks tuskless females, and gold marks tusked females. Historical film and photographs give the prewar group. Later sightings give the survivors. The bars use the reported group sizes and percentages.
scenes.caption: Teal marks tuskless females, and gold marks tusked females. Historical film and photographs give the prewar group. Later sightings give the survivors. The bars use the reported group sizes and percentages.
scenes.visual: Build two computed stacked bars from the reported data. Label them prewar and war survivors. Show 18.5% of 54 in teal on the first and 50.9% of 108 in teal on the second. Gold fills each remainder.
scenes.narration: Teal marks tuskless females, and gold marks tusked females. Historical film and photographs give the prewar group. Later sightings give the survivors. The bars use the reported group sizes and percentages.

scenes.tts: The teal share is higher among survivors. What changed? Did individual elephants lose tusks, or do the two groups contain different shares of elephants born with each trait?
scenes.caption: The teal share is higher among survivors. What changed? Did individual elephants lose tusks, or do the two groups contain different shares of elephants born with each trait?
scenes.visual: Keep both computed bars large. Pull one gold and one teal elephant marker out of the prewar bar and place matching outlines near the survivor bar. Put the two possible explanations above them with question marks.
scenes.narration: The teal share is higher among survivors. What changed? Did individual elephants lose tusks, or do the two groups contain different shares of elephants born with each trait?

scenes.visual: Hold the predict question and both computed bars. The matching gold and teal outlines pulse gently, but no colors or labels change.

scenes.tts: Track two schematic animals between panels. A gold animal stays gold, and a teal animal stays teal. The survivor group contains more teal because tuskless females survived poaching more often.
scenes.caption: Track two schematic animals between panels. A gold animal stays gold, and a teal animal stays teal. The survivor group contains more teal because tuskless females survived poaching more often.
scenes.visual: Move the tracked gold and teal markers along fixed-color paths. More gold paths fade before the survivor group; more teal paths continue. Keep the bars visible and do not label any group extinct or rejected.
scenes.narration: Track two schematic animals between panels. A gold animal stays gold, and a teal animal stays teal. The survivor group contains more teal because tuskless females survived poaching more often.

scenes.tts: Ivory poaching was a selective pressure because it affected the variants differently. Tusked elephants were killed more often. The data support a change in the population's makeup, not a choice or transformation by elephants.
scenes.caption: Ivory poaching was a selective pressure because it affected the variants differently. Tusked elephants were killed more often. The data support a change in the population's makeup, not a choice or transformation by elephants.
scenes.visual: Transform the paths into a large selection filter labelled ivory poaching. Narrow the gold passage more than the teal passage. Use 'supported explanation' beside the changed group and cross out only the choice-or-transformation cartoon.
scenes.narration: Ivory poaching was a selective pressure because it affected the variants differently. Tusked elephants were killed more often. The data support a change in the population's makeup, not a choice or transformation by elephants.

scenes.tts: A severe population crash can also change shares by chance. Researchers modeled the crash with equal survival for tusked and tuskless females. The observed rise was far beyond what that chance model usually produced.
scenes.caption: A severe population crash can also change shares by chance. Researchers modeled the crash with equal survival for tusked and tuskless females. The observed rise was far beyond what that chance model usually produced.
scenes.visual: Split the frame. Left: a large block labelled 'equal-survival simulation' feeds a result range marked 'schematic'. Right: keep the computed real survivor bar and show the observed line at 50.9%, far beyond the schematic range.
scenes.narration: A severe population crash can also change shares by chance. Researchers modeled the crash with equal survival for tusked and tuskless females. The observed rise was far beyond what that chance model usually produced.

scenes.tts: Daughters born later kept tusklessness above the prewar share. That pattern fits an inherited trait and a response to selection. It still does not identify the exact allele or prove what happened to every elephant.
scenes.caption: Daughters born later kept tusklessness above the prewar share. That pattern fits an inherited trait and a response to selection. It still does not identify the exact allele or prove what happened to every elephant.
scenes.visual: Add the third computed bar for postwar daughters, with 33% of 91 in teal. Connect the three bars with a thin timeline. Beside it, show separate labels 'visible trait' and 'exact allele unknown'.
scenes.narration: Daughters born later kept tusklessness above the prewar share. That pattern fits an inherited trait and a response to selection. It still does not identify the exact allele or prove what happened to every elephant.

scenes.tts: Now widen the picture. Populations usually produce more young than their environments can support. A female blue crab carries an enormous egg mass. An elephant mother invests years in a calf. Most crab young die before reproducing.
scenes.caption: Now widen the picture. Populations usually produce more young than their environments can support. A female blue crab carries an enormous egg mass. An elephant mother invests years in a calf. Most crab young die before reproducing.
scenes.visual: Slide from the data bars to a full-frame schematic range. At the left, a blue crab carries a dense orange egg mass. At the right, an elephant and calf move together. A narrowing environment gate remains between young and reproducing adults.
scenes.narration: Now widen the picture. Populations usually produce more young than their environments can support. A female blue crab carries an enormous egg mass. An elephant mother invests years in a calf. Most crab young die before reproducing.

scenes.tts: These are endpoints on a range, not two rigid boxes. One strategy makes many young with less investment in each. The other makes fewer young with more care. Many species fall between them.
scenes.caption: These are endpoints on a range, not two rigid boxes. One strategy makes many young with less investment in each. The other makes fewer young with more care. Many species fall between them.
scenes.visual: Turn the crab and elephant panels into opposite ends of one continuous double-headed arrow labelled reproductive strategies. Several unlabeled animal silhouettes settle between them. Keep the whole display labelled 'schematic'.
scenes.narration: These are endpoints on a range, not two rigid boxes. One strategy makes many young with less investment in each. The other makes fewer young with more care. Many species fall between them.

scenes.tts: For selection, count offspring that survive and reproduce. Strength, effort, and need are not the score. The conditions decide whether an inherited variant changes reproductive success.
scenes.caption: For selection, count offspring that survive and reproduce. Strength, effort, and need are not the score. The conditions decide whether an inherited variant changes reproductive success.
scenes.visual: Reuse the survival-and-reproduction filter. Offspring that later reproduce send small teal or gold markers into the next generation. Strength, effort, and need labels drift away; offspring left remains centered.
scenes.narration: For selection, count offspring that survive and reproduce. Strength, effort, and need are not the score. The conditions decide whether an inherited variant changes reproductive success.

scenes.tts: When inherited variations affect reproductive success, populations change across generations. In Gorongosa, the trait pattern, selective pressure, survival difference, and daughters all support that rule together.
scenes.caption: When inherited variations affect reproductive success, populations change across generations. In Gorongosa, the trait pattern, selective pressure, survival difference, and daughters all support that rule together.
scenes.visual: Bring the three computed Gorongosa bars back beside the schematic filter. Four evidence strands, labelled trait pattern, pressure, survival, and daughters, braid into one line pointing toward 'selection supported'.
scenes.narration: When inherited variations affect reproductive success, populations change across generations. In Gorongosa, the trait pattern, selective pressure, survival difference, and daughters all support that rule together.

scenes.tts: Before-and-after data show a pattern. The selective pressure, survival estimate, chance comparison, and later daughters make the selection explanation stronger. Good evidence supports a claim while keeping its limits visible.
scenes.caption: Before-and-after data show a pattern. The selective pressure, survival estimate, chance comparison, and later daughters make the selection explanation stronger. Good evidence supports a claim while keeping its limits visible.
scenes.visual: Place a transparent frame labelled evidence around the bars and model. Keep a visible open edge labelled limits. The selection-supported line brightens, but never changes to 'proved' or 'only cause'.
scenes.narration: Before-and-after data show a pattern. The selective pressure, survival estimate, chance comparison, and later daughters make the selection explanation stronger. Good evidence supports a claim while keeping its limits visible.

scenes.tts: Read the bars as population snapshots, not biographies. Read the filter as a comparison, not a promise. Then ask whether inherited differences changed who left the next generation.
scenes.caption: Read the bars as population snapshots, not biographies. Read the filter as a comparison, not a promise. Then ask whether inherited differences changed who left the next generation.
scenes.visual: Transform the bars into three large snapshots on a timeline. The filter sits between snapshots with teal and gold paths. A question moves beneath them: who left the next generation?
scenes.narration: Read the bars as population snapshots, not biographies. Read the filter as a comparison, not a promise. Then ask whether inherited differences changed who left the next generation.

scenes.visual: End card with one line only: 'When inherited variations affect reproductive success, populations change across generations.'
